legacyTitle: 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course, Get Certified
legacyDescription: Join our 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course and become a professional yoga instructor. Start your transformative journey today!

blocks.text: Embody and teach yoga with confidence, skill and secure foundation of knowledge. Inspirational and educational training that will enable you to find your individual voice as a teacher and establish a deep connection within yourself. Avana Yoga offers teacher training courses in the UK and India.
On completion of the training, students will

items: Know, and be able to apply, the Principles of Alignment
Have learnt to apply the art of observation and adjustment in asana
Understand and be able to apply the art of sequencing
Be able to confidently teach led classes, including basic meditation and pranayama techniques
Understand, and be able to explain, the roots and philosophy of yoga.
Be confident in using Sanskrit names of asana
Understand, and be able to explain, the chakras and subtle body anatomy
This course will be delivered in English and therefore a good understanding of spoken and written English is required.

Students should recognise that the course will be demanding throughout. Successful completion of the course will require significant effort, focus and dedication. In this respect, students should ensure that they are emotionally and physically fit for this undertaking and fully committed to the course
Students should have a personal yoga practice, an open mind and a willingness to learn.
If you are unsure of your eligibility to book onto the training, please contact us for advice

blocks.text: The certificate will be awarded on successful completion of the course.

Avana Yoga is accredited by Yoga Alliance USA. On successful completion of the training, students will be able to register with Yoga Alliance as a 200-hour RYT (registered yoga teacher). Written and practical assessments will have to be completed at the end of the course; in order to graduate students must attend a minimum of 90% of the course. Should a student miss more than this, they will be required to take catch-up classes as agreed with the tutor. These will incur an additional charge.
Course Fee: £1899 (Early Bird, ends on 30th June 2026)
Hear directly from our graduates about their transformative journeys. Discover how our teacher training program has empowered them to grow, both on and off the mat.

A person who inspires. Yogi Madhav inspires yoga in everything he does , hes totally devote to it and hes always happy to share hes knowledge with everyone , im really happy our paths came across .

items.title: Experienced and Knowledgeable Teachers
items.text: The teachers at Avana Yoga are highly experienced and knowledgeable in the field of yoga. They have dedicated their lives to the practice of yoga and have undergone extensive training to become certified yoga teachers. They are passionate about sharing their knowledge and helping students to develop a deep understanding of the practice of yoga. The teachers at Avana Yoga will guide you through every aspect of the course, from the philosophy of yoga to the practical aspects of teaching.

items.title: Comprehensive Curriculum
items.text: The curriculum at Avana Yoga is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the practice of yoga. The course covers a wide range of topics, including yoga philosophy, asana practice, pranayama, meditation, anatomy, and teaching methodology. The curriculum is designed to ensure that students have a solid foundation in all aspects of yoga, enabling them to become confident and competent yoga teachers.

items.title: Small Class Sizes
items.text: At Avana Yoga, we believe that small class sizes are essential for providing high-quality training. That’s why we limit our class sizes to ensure that each student receives personalised attention from our teachers. This approach allows our teachers to focus on the individual needs of each student, ensuring that they receive the support and guidance they need to succeed.

items.title: Certification
items.text: Upon completion of the 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course, students will receive a certification from Avana Yoga. Our certification is internationally recognised, allowing you to teach yoga in any country in the world. The certification is also recognised by the Yoga Alliance, which is the largest international nonprofit association representing the yoga community. This recognition provides our students with the confidence and credibility they need to pursue a career in yoga.

items.title: Community
items.text: At Avana Yoga, we believe that the community is an essential aspect of the practice of yoga. We have created a warm and welcoming community of students and teachers who support each other on their yoga journey. Our community provides a space for students to connect, share experiences, and develop lifelong friendships. We also offer ongoing support to our graduates, providing them with opportunities to continue their learning and development.

items.title: Affordability
items.text: At Avana Yoga, we believe that yoga should be accessible to everyone. That’s why we offer our 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course at an affordable price. We believe that high-quality yoga training should not be prohibitively expensive, and we strive to make our courses accessible to all.

items.q: What is the duration of the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: The 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course offered by Avana Yoga is a comprehensive program that spans over the duration of 10 weekends.

items.q: What is the eligibility criteria for enrolling in the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: To enroll in a 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course, candidates should be in good physical health and fitness, as the program involves physical activity and yoga postures. While prior yoga experience is not always required, having a basic understanding of yoga can be helpful. A strong commitment to learning and deepening your personal practice is essential, as well as a genuine interest in teaching others. Most programs require participants to be at least 18 years old, although some may accept younger students with parental consent. Additionally, basic proficiency in English is typically required, as most courses are taught in English.

items.q: What will be the course curriculum of the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: The Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course curriculum covers a wide range of topics such as yoga philosophy, anatomy and physiology, teaching methodology, asanas, pranayama, meditation, and more. The course is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of yoga and its various aspects.

items.q: What kind of certification will I receive after completing the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: Upon successful completion of the course, students will receive a certification from Avana Yoga, which is recognised by the Yoga Alliance. This certification will enable students to become registered yoga teachers and teach yoga anywhere in the world.

items.q: Will I be able to teach yoga after completing the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: Yes, upon successful completion of the course, students will be eligible to teach yoga with confident.

items.q: What is the class size for the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: The class size for the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course is limited to 10 students. This ensures that each student receives individual attention and guidance from the teachers.

items.q: What is the teaching methodology used in the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: The teaching methodology used in the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course is a combination of traditional and modern approaches. The course emphasises the importance of experiential learning and provides ample opportunities for students to practice teaching under the guidance of experienced teachers.

items.q: What kind of support will I receive after completing the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: Avana Yoga provides continuous support to its students even after they complete the course. Students can reach out to the teachers for guidance and support, and Avana Yoga also provides opportunities for students to continue their learning through advanced courses and workshops.
